In any production, 20% of the bulbs are of Type-A, 30% are of Type-B and 50% are of Type-C. Then answer the given questions

questions.text: Inscript DMS is giving a replacement warranty for bulbs that last for less than 100 hours of life. The replacement will cost Rs. 2 for every Type-A bulb, Rs. 1.75 for every Type-B bulb and Rs. 3 for every Type-C bulb. Then, if 10,000 bulbs are produced and sold in a year, what would be the total warranty related cost that DMS will expect to incur? (Note: Input your answer rounded to two decimal places . For example, if your answer is “1.235” then enter the answer as “1.24”)
